method: Direct image inspection of actual player Markdown, MathJax, fieldControl, radio controls and MathLive blank screenshots after including exact player navigation/theme CSS.
findings: Prompts, full five-choice radios, and blank control visible.
n+1 numerator/denominator and arbitrary C display correctly, including zero case.
